entities.name: Cornel Călugăreanu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Corneliu Călugăreanu was a Romanian basketball player who competed in the 1952 Summer Olympics. He was born in Drăgănești-Vlașca, Teleorman. He was part of the Romanian basketball team that was eliminated in the first round of the 1952 tournament. He played both matches.
